as_told.title: 'Norton Air Force Base internal' PDF on Greer's DPI archive

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for government disclosure of UFO secrets, says he has a full transcript of a man named Brad Sorensen talking to an aerospace writer. In it, Greer says, Sorensen describes "ARVs", alien reproduction vehicles, meaning human-built craft copied from alien ones, being built since the late 1950s, and seeing them at Norton Air Force Base in California in 1988. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb points to what seems the same file, posted online as a Norton base internal document dated 1990 and naming the writer as Bill Scott.
